symptom: On Mendix 10.24.18 (and every 10.24 patch below 10.24.24) a nanoflow re-created with `drop nanoflow` + `create nanoflow` made `mx diff` exit 129: `Objects with ID 71e6faf6-… of type Microflows$Nanoflow do not have the same properties. baseNames = …, ExportLevel, …, ReturnVariableName; newNames = …`; a fresh microflow and entity lacked AggregateAction UseExpression/Expression/ReduceInitialValueExpression/ReduceReturnDataType, DeleteAction.ErrorHandlingType, WhileLoopCondition.Caption, DatabaseRetrieveSource.XpathConstraint and EntityImpl Image/Source/ImageData; `mxcli fix property-sets --dry-run` said `Every unit already has the property names Studio Pro writes.` mx check 0 errors throughout (ako/mxcli#1505, mendixlabs/mxcli#1595)
cause: Every one of those keys was a row of studiopro_property_defaults.json with since 10.24.24, the lowest version the table had been MEASURED on (CI's 10.24 is 10.24.24), and propertyDefault.appliesTo reads since as the version that introduced the key, so 10.24.0–10.24.23 got none of them. fix property-sets judged completeness by the same table, so it could not see what the table did not cover
file: `modelsdk/canon/studiopro_property_defaults.json` (94 rows to since 10.24.0, measured), `modelsdk/mpr/property_set_census.go` + `cmd/mxcli/cmd_fix_property_sets.go` (MIXED report); tests `modelsdk/canon/propertyset_issue1505_test.go`, `TestFixPropertySets_ReportsAKeyNoMeasuredValueFills`, `modelsdk/mpr/property_set_census_test.go`; bug-test `mdl-examples/bug-tests/1505-property-sets-below-10-24-24.mdl`
insight: **A table floor is only as low as the oldest version measured: measure the lowest patch of a line (10.24.0), not the one CI runs.** **Strip-and-convert measures a row without needing a writer to leave it out**: delete the row's key from every element of a blank Studio Pro app (plus probe content for types the template lacks), `fix hashes --repair`, `mx convert -p -s` a copy, and every key Mendix writes back is a measurement with its value. It measured 53 rows on 10.24.0 and 10.24.18 in minutes, including ~30 the doctype gate cannot see because today's writers emit them (gaps there come only from units an older mxcli stored). Two traps: never strip a key whose value holds elements (a non-empty Widgets or Items list), which deletes the subtree being measured so convert re-adds only empty lists; and convert without -s fails its check on stripped values. Feed the result to propdefaults as a Recording line, so Merge refuses a value that varies. **The doctype gate is blind on a script with a marketplace dependency on 10.24**: after `mx module-import` it logs `MPR v1 project, nothing to compare per unit` and passes; 13-business-events did, while its BusinessEventService lacked Document. **The project is its own reference for property NAMES, not values**: Studio Pro writes the same key set on every element of a $Type (0 mixed of 115–252 types on pedapp, expr-checker, testapp-views and blank 10.24.0/10.24.18 apps), so fix property-sets now reports any name the elements of a type disagree on (MIXED). With the old table it named 7 of the issue's 10 type.keys on 10.24.18 (the other 3 had no sibling element in a blank app), and it fills none, since a value from another version or element is a guess. Suggestion 3 (carry the dropped nanoflow's header) was skipped: once the completion writes the names, drop + create is a new document and Hidden is its right ExportLevel. After the fix `mx convert` still rewrites mxcli's units with 0 key differences: key ORDER only, which the merge does not compare
